To calculate the percentage change in the basic and diluted net loss per share between 2018 and 2019, we use the formula for percentage change:

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = \frac{\text{New Value} - \text{Old Value}}{\text{Old Value}} \times 100 \]

From the table, the net loss per share for 2019 is $(0.22) and for 2018 is $(0.40).

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = \frac{(-0.22) - (-0.40)}{-0.40} \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = \frac{-0.22 + 0.40}{-0.40} \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = \frac{0.18}{-0.40} \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = -0.45 \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage Change} = -45\% \]
